rows.en:
Waruder is starting to get in the way! If need be, you may destroy him!

Whatever happens… kill every last one of the Kikaiders!
Leave the rest to me… Shadow Knight! Go!
Yes, Lord Zadam…
Zadam… get the Robot Regenerator ready!
The Robot Regenerator!?
Heh heh heh… Hahahaha!
Oh? That's unusual…
What's wrong, Mr. Tachibana?
A letter, from Waruder…

…!?

Mr. Tachibana, is that for me…?

Let's see…

It's addressed to…

Ichiro!
Me?
To Ichiro?
What's this!? It's a challenge letter from Waruder!
A challenge letter!?

I have a bad feeling about this. This challenge letter… is it really from Waruder?

[HERO2], what do you think?
"It might be a trap?" "That's just Waruder's way…"
What are you going to do, Brother Ichiro!

I understand how you all feel…

Waruder is someone even I don't want to kill!

But… as long as Waruder is employed by Shadow… I have to do it!
Waruder! I accept your challenge!
As expected of Lord Zero-One…

Sending a challenge letter fair and square… You are a worthy opponent indeed!

My battle circuit has issued the order to kill as well! Lord Zero-One… today we settle this without fail!
(Ugh… He has no openings! What a frightening opponent…)
Have at you!
Change! Kikaideeer! …Zero, One!
Here I come! Waruder!
Kyaaaah!

…!?

Damn it! My attack hit Bijinder…!?

Bijinder! Are you all right!? Hang in there! Mari!

…!?

Damn it! My attack hit Bijinder…!?

Bijinder! Are you all right!? Hang in there! Mari!
L-Lady Bijinder…

Ugh… I-I'm all right… More importantly…

Wait! This fight is… a trap… set up by Shadow…! The challenge letter is a fake.
What!? Shadow's…?
Is that true!?
Is that true!?
Come out, Shadow Knight! If you won't come out… I'll come to you!
Waruder! Waruderrr!

…!?

Bijinder!?

…!?

Bijinder!?

Uoooh… L-Lady Bijinder!

My life… had only a week left anyway, but if I am to be killed all the same, then by y-you… Ugh…
Waruderrr! Waruderrr!

Lady Bijinder…

In the end, I am… only a manufactured machine, and the lowest of killers among them.

I tried to understand at least as much of the heart as you possess, Lady Bijinder, but it was no use… Ugh…
Waruderrr!

Heh heh heh… Since you've seen through it, it can't be helped.

Zero-One… I'll dispose of you myself! Waruder! Heh heh heh… you too!
This is not what we agreed, Shadow Knight! I was to be the only one to kill Zero-One…

Heh heh heh… That's right!

And just now… you lost to Zero-One! Useless junk… Die!
Nuoooh…

Heh heh heh… Your fighting strength has dropped from the fight with Waruder!

Zero-One… this is your grave!

Heh heh heh… It seems the fight is decided?

Zero-One… I'll dispose of you myself! Waruder! Heh heh heh… you too!
This is not what we agreed, Shadow Knight! Ugh… I was to be… the only one to kill Zero-One…

Heh heh heh… That's right!

And just now… you lost to Zero-One! Useless junk… This is the end!
You coward, Shadow Knight! Why don't you fight fair and square, like Waruder?
Heh heh heh… That's just what I'm about to do!
Mari, get Waruder somewhere safe…
Bijinder, get Waruder somewhere safe…
Got it!
Here I come! Shadow Knight!
Here I come! Shadow Knight!

Ngh… You Kikaiders! But don't think you've won!

Our Great World Crime Organization Shadow has the Robot Regenerator! Hahahaha!
Ngh… You Kikaiders! But don't think you've won.
…!? What's that sound?
Shadow Knight, grand executive of the Great World Crime Organization Shadow! I won't let you do as you please!
Hmph, perfect timing… I'll dispose of you along with them!
Not a chance!
Don't worry about Waruder! I got him somewhere safe…
All right, let's go!
All right, let's go!
Are you all right, Waruder?

Pay it no mind, Lord Kikaider…

This wound is due to my own lack of skill… Careless sympathy will cost you your life! I am in Shadow's employ…
Wait! That Shadow… tried to take your life, Waruder!

The duel with Lord Zero-One was indeed my defeat.

I had resolved to become scrap and meet a pitiful end…

And yet you, of all things, saved one such as I, your enemy… Why?

Sadly… that is what I cannot understand.

Only… never take pity on me again. That would make me far… far too wretched!

Waruder, that's not true!

You and I are both machines, built to the same fate… But I have learned to have hope.
An android, with hope?

Yes…

I've lived with only one wish… that someday I'd become an android with a righteous heart, like Jiro and Ichiro!

And… that hope came true.

Hope, dreams…

All is in vain…

My life… no, for one like me who cannot even tell good from evil, a righteous heart is far beyond reach…

After all, I am nothing but a killer! Farewell…
Waruder!? Where do you think you're going in that state? Don't tell me… you're going after Shadow alone!?
It goes without saying… I shall avenge the humiliation I suffered!
Then… we'll go with you!

Lord Zero-One…

Please… do not spoil my final moments. This is my own affair… And so, farewell.

U12442-U12443: Waruder's line continues in a narration-kind row.
U12446: Ichiro's transformation call kept: "Change! Kikaideeer! …Zero, One!"
U12460: Waruder, struck down (attacker not shown, likely Shadow Knight), says that if he must be killed he would rather it be by Bijinder; "by y-you…" kept unfinished.
U12465-U12472: two variants of the same scene (before/after the duel).
U12473: 専怯 read as 卑怯 "coward".
U12483: 世界大犯罪組織シャドウ rendered "Great World Crime Organization Shadow".
U12489-U12490: Jiro is addressed by Waruder as "Lord Kikaider".
